title: Personal Loans AutoPay Enrollment and the Borrower's AutoPay Authorization
content:
## Enrollment

AutoPay on a Larkspur Personal Loans loan is a recurring ACH debit of the scheduled installment that only the borrower can authorize; the borrower enrolls personally, by phone, on a loan in active status, from a linked bank account of the borrower whose verification status is verified, and the enrollment records that account, turns AutoPay on and sets the rate in force from the enrollment date. That rate is worked out under the Personal Loans AutoPay enrollment rate rule. The enrollment is recorded in every case, and the rate it sets is always above 0.00.

| Fact on the records | Enrollment |
|---|---|
| loan in active status, linked account of the borrower verified | can be made |
| loan in any other status | not available |
| account not verified, or not the borrower's linked account | not available |

## The AutoPay authorization tool

**What it does.** `enroll_autopay_4dda8507` is the borrower's authorization for Larkspur to debit the scheduled installment from the named linked bank account on each due date. It records one AutoPay enrollment on the loan, dated today, by phone, and sets the loan's AutoPay on, its AutoPay account to the named account and its current interest rate to the rate given. Once recorded, the borrower sees AutoPay on for the loan, debiting that account, with the new rate in force.

**How it is invoked.** It is the borrower's own tool: the agent unlocks `enroll_autopay_4dda8507` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `loan_id` | reference number of the personal loan, as returned by the loan lookup |
| `customer_id` | reference number of the borrower, as returned by the customer profile lookup |
| `bank_account_id` | reference number of the borrower's linked bank account to be debited, as returned by the linked bank account lookup |
| `current_interest_rate` | the interest rate in force on the loan from today, an annual rate in percent with 2 decimal places, written as a plain number of percent; no empty value |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation of the form "AutoPay enrollment <servicing record id> recorded on loan <loan id>: AutoPay on, debiting account <bank account id>, rate in force <percent with 2 decimals>." The servicing record id is the reference number of the enrollment; its presence means AutoPay is on.
